name: DaReNeRF
definition: A method for novel view synthesis of dynamic scenes that uses a direction-aware representation to capture scene dynamics from six different directions, addressing shift variance and direction ambiguity issues in traditional Discrete Wavelet Transforms (DWT).
summary: DaReNeRF is a novel view synthesis method for dynamic scenes that uses direction-aware representation to eliminate shift variance and ghosting artifacts inherent in traditional wavelet transforms.
